652: The whole day is suitable... - and if one did not take the species until bein hashmashot, on the first day one is obligated then to take it, since it is a doubt on a Biblical obligation [with which the general rule is to be stringent]. And one should do so without a blessing (since blessings are Rabbinic obligations). And the acharonim agreed with regards the latter days of the festival that even though it is a rabbinic obligation, so too here it is correct to take the species, since there is no trouble in this -- but one should be careful not to bless on this taking.

At the time of Hallel -- in order to wave it at "Hodu" and "Hoshia na". And some of the scrupulous are accustomed to bless on the lulav at neitz hachama within the sukkah and to wave it, and afterwards during Hallel to wave it again.
